name: my-games-hub
description: Quality, smoke-test, and release tooling for the My Games static hub

scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:resources && npm run check:storage && npm run check:secrets && npm run check:artifacts && npm run lint
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json eslint.config.js playwright.config.js tests tools/check-artifacts.js tools/check-js-syntax.js tools/check-local-resources.js tools/check-secrets.js tools/check-storage-manifest.js tools/release.js
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:smoke
